verdict.rationale: The pack confirms Airwallex has a dispute-management process and agent tooling (AgentOS MCP, CLI), but nothing documents retrieving disputes, uploading evidence, or submitting dispute responses through the API or by an agent. AgentOS skills cover billing, beneficiaries, cards and cashflow, not disputes. The CLI's generic 'broad slice of the API' wording does not establish dispute endpoints, so the only support is adjacent.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API
